build_concat_dataset: build a ConcatDataset to concatenate multiple BaseDataset instances with lazy initialization support
build_repeat_dataset: build a RepeatDataset to repeat a BaseDataset N times for faster epoch data loading
build_class_balanced_dataset: build a ClassBalancedDataset to oversample rare categories using a frequency threshold
review_concatdataset_metainfo: review the ConcatDataset metainfo property that returns a deep copy of the first dataset metadata
refactor_classbalanceddataset_repeat_fac: refactor the ClassBalancedDataset _get_repeat_factors method to compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency
